title: HOW TO DANCE TO REGGAETON MUSIC IN THE CLUB TUTORIAL (3 EASY MOVES)

method.teacher_system: Monika introduces three basic reggaeton moves focusing on hips and knees, breaks down each step with counts and tempo variation, and demonstrates how to combine and transition between them.
method.signature: Structuring the tutorial by breaking down club movement into three isolated hip-and-knee actions before demonstrating foot travel and arm styling.

practices.what: Introduce the first move focusing entirely on hip action through bending one knee at a time in place.
Practice the hip and knee action to counts at a slightly faster tempo.
Introduce the second move, adding a small lift and forward step while maintaining the bent knee landing.
Address the common error of straightening the leg when stepping down, emphasizing keeping the knee bent upon contact.
Introduce the third move, adding forward and backward travel inch by inch while keeping the knee bent on landing.
Practice traveling forward and back slowly with counts before picking up the pace.
Discuss arm options, advising to add arms only when the lower body movement is 100% mastered.

adaptations.difficulty: Adding arm movements while learning footwork and hips
adaptations.adjustment: Keep arms bent and moving randomly with the body as the easiest option for beginners.

moments.says: The teacher welcomes the learner and introduces three basic reggaeton moves, promising a combination tutorial at the end.
The teacher invites the learner to comment below with their favorite move and the one they will try on the dance floor.
The teacher identifies walking back as the most difficult part and encourages the learner to focus on keeping the knee bent.

mentor.what_stays: The teacher leaves the learner feeling equipped and confident to dance reggaeton in social settings.
